title: Polychares
summary: Raleigh names Polychares in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Polychares, a Messenian, who slew many Lacedaemonians after Euaephnes had slaine his Sonne. The Sonnes name is not printed. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XXVII, §. IV, sig. 364b–365a
